newsitem.title: UK: British Gas may cut bills - paper.
newsitem.headline: British Gas may cut bills - paper.

text.p: British Gas is set to announce on Tuesday that it will cut bills in the South East of England by an average of 40 pounds a year to win back customers in the region, The Independent newspaper said.
The paper said this was the first time British Gas has introduced different prices for customers in different parts of the country.

The South East is a crucial region for British Gas. Since competitive trials were set up there last April, British Gas has lost 19 percent of its customers to rival operators who undercut its tariffs, the paper said.
